definitions.explanation: having a dark, depressing, or cheerless quality

examples.japanese: {陰気|いんき}な⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{陰気|いんき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This room has a dreary atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{陰気|いんき}な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{黙|だま}っていた→黙る：02287_damaru⟧。
examples.english: He sat silently with a gloomy expression.

notes:
{陰気|いんき} is a na-adjective describing a dark, gloomy, or depressing quality in people, places, weather, or atmosphere.

ETYMOLOGY:
{陰|いん} (yin, shadow, negative) + ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (spirit, atmosphere). Rooted in the ⟦{陰陽|いんよう}→陰陽：28954_inyou⟧ (yin-yang) concept.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {陰気|いんき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧ (gloomy atmosphere)
- Adverbial: {陰気|いんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{黙|だま}り{込|こ}む→黙り込む：18270_damarikomu⟧ (sit in gloomy silence)

CAN DESCRIBE:
- ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧: weather (dreary, overcast)
- ⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: atmosphere (depressing)
- ⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: personality (gloomy, somber)
- ⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: places (dark, cheerless)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{陽気|ようき}→陽気：03657_youki⟧: cheerful, lively, bright — the direct opposite
- ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧: dark (more general, also literal darkness)
- ⟦{憂鬱|ゆううつ}→憂鬱：05821_yuuutsu⟧: depressed, melancholy (focuses on internal feelings)
- ⟦じめじめ→じめじめ：05789_jimejime⟧: damp and gloomy (onomatopoeia, physical sensation)
